reader: The engine builds button.variants.<color>.<appearance> from these tones (the component's matrix); shared/OButton.tsx reads the variants

shared/OInput.tsx, shared/OTextarea.tsx, shared/OSelect.tsx and shared/OOtpInput.tsx paint each state as a whole look (nativeBoxStyle(states.focus)) and reserve the widest border of the states (reservedBorder)
shared/FilterChip.tsx paints the pressed, selected and disabled states as whole looks (nativeBoxStyle, reservedBorder)
